snippet.title: DESOLUS Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1003460/DESOLUS/

Explore a city of Gothic architecture torn between past and future in Desolus, a first person puzzle game. Solve Escher-like puzzles through the use of black holes. Travel through time to make structures whole and save the city from ruin.
